title: dfilter: Add location support for some expressions
description:
```
Filter: tcp.port < _ws.ftypes.uint40 + _ws.ftypes.double
dftest: FT_UINT40 and FT_DOUBLE are not type compatible.
    tcp.port < _ws.ftypes.uint40 + _ws.ftypes.double
               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

At some point there should probably be comments indicating that a "location" is a location within the text of a packet-matching expression, for use when reporting an error, to indicate to the user what part of the expression is erroneous.
